what: Cartoon kart racing with power-ups and friends.

fanProjects.name: SuperTuxKart
fanProjects.what: A free kart racer with lots of tracks, power-ups, online races and story mode.
howToPlay: Download it from supertuxkart.net (Windows, Mac, Linux, Android).
Pick a driver and a track and race!

lovedFeatures: Power-ups you pick up on the track
extraFeatures: Split-screen for 2 players on one screen
legalNote: Nintendo protects its characters very strongly. Make your own drivers, items, tracks and name.
